title: Dyson's New Products: V8 Cyclone, Robot Vacuum & More
text:
Dyson Unveils New Lineup Including⁣ revamped V8,Advanced ‌ V16 ,and⁣ Compact Air⁤ Purifier October‌ 24,2024 – Dyson today announced a⁤ range of new products ​spanning floor‌ care and air purification,wiht availability staggered between late 2024 and 2026. The lineup includes a refreshed ⁤version of the⁣ popular V8⁣ cordless ‍vacuum,the ⁤high-performance V16 Piston Animal ,and the new HushJet Purifier‌ Compact HJ10 ‌air purifier,slated for release by⁢ the end of‌ this month.
The company detailed several additional floor care innovations arriving in 2026, building on the previously ⁣announced ​PencilVac.⁣ Among ‌the highlights is the Dyson V8 Cyclone,​ a reimagining of the ⁤2016⁤ model​ boasting ‍30⁣ percent‍ more suction power – 150​ air watts – and double the runtime, now ⁣reaching 60 minutes.⁢ It features a triggerless power button and compatibility with a self-emptying docking station.
Dyson‍ also introduced the V16‌ Piston Animal ⁣cordless ‌stick‌ vacuum,‌ equipped with‍ Dyson’s latest motor and a “All Floor Cones Sense” cleaner head. ⁣This head automatically adjusts suction and brush bar speed​ based on floor type and includes LED illumination. The V16 also ⁢supports‌ an updated wet roller head, dubbed ‌Submarine⁢ 2.0, previously featured on the Dyson V15 Detect, and incorporates ⁣a‍ wipe-clean bin mechanism for easier debris⁣ removal.A self-emptying docking station⁣ will​ be‍ available separately.
Expanding beyond stick vacuums, Dyson unveiled the Dyson clean+Wash ⁣Hygiene, a new⁤ wet and dry floor cleaner designed with a filter-free system to contain collected debris within the⁢ cleaner head. This differs ⁢from the company’s existing WashG1,which ‍is a wet-only floor cleaner.
The HushJet Purifier Compact HJ10 air purifier ‌will‍ be the ⁣first product from this declaration to⁢ hit the market, retailing for $350. Pricing and specific release dates ⁢for ‍the remaining‍ products will be announced closer to their respective launches in 2026.
